[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 9: Ship saving[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.1[/color] [color=#00fffb]Ships are to be no larger than 80x50 tiles.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.2[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do not abuse the ship save mechanic to avoid in-character consequences.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.3[/color] [color=#00fffb]Ship saving backups are only to be used in the event of ship destruction or loss due to a server crash or other unforseen issue. Loading backups otherwise is only to be done with admin permission.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.4[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do not under any circumstances modify a ship save file without admin permission (like with the engine update).[/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.5[/color] [color=#00fffb]DO NOT ADD MORE THAN ONE BLUESPACE STASH PER SHIP.[/color]
